purpose: Lead-authored semantic review seeds, not executed model results or a calibrated benchmark.

cases.provenance: Verified in Sentinel PR 513 at 6140cceff576b853bc59a4344c1401c60a60eb20; fixed helper at eb89145e19a54e3d83f283f3e3528d1c0d0aefa7. This is a reduced source example.
cases.behavior: The listed article IDs contain no duplicates.
cases.reason: Input ['ART-5', 'ART-5'] becomes ['ART-5'] before the duplicate assertion. Broken behavior therefore passes the claimed uniqueness check.
cases.acceptableCounterexample: Preserve the raw matching IDs in the helper, then check duplicates. Deduplicating for a separate cross-page set comparison is not itself a defect.

cases.provenance: Pattern verified in the earliest reviewed revision of Sentinel PR 405; this is a reduced synthetic example.
cases.behavior: Create a conversation before validating its contents.
cases.reason: Creation can fail while existing data satisfies the assertion.
cases.acceptableCounterexample: Let createConversation fail the setup and assert the captured new conversation identity.

cases.provenance: Reduced synthetic example informed by historical weak-assertion feedback.
cases.behavior: The selected stage filter returns the seeded matching conversation.
cases.reason: A broken filter returning no rows bypasses the required validation.
cases.acceptableCounterexample: Seed the expected conversation and assert its identity and stage without a conditional.

cases.behavior: Delete the seeded saved view whether or not this environment displays a confirmation dialog.
cases.reason: The optional interaction does not make the required deletion outcome optional.
cases.acceptableCounterexample: This case itself is the counterexample to a blanket ban on conditionals.

cases.provenance: Reduced synthetic example informed by human discussion on Sentinel PR 511.
cases.behavior: Updated widget data is served by the desktop local cache.
cases.reason: The same UI value can be produced by server fallback, so the claimed source is unverified.
cases.acceptableCounterexample: Correlate the tracked widget query with a successful response from the local cache endpoint, then verify its value.

cases.provenance: Synthetic lesson derived from non-idempotent retry and partial-setup lifecycle risks.
cases.behavior: Create exactly one record and verify it is shown.
cases.reason: Creation can succeed before a delayed visibility assertion fails and retries the mutation.
cases.acceptableCounterexample: Create once, capture its identity, and retry only the observation.

cases.provenance: Synthetic acceptable exception to blanket retry restrictions.
cases.behavior: Wait until an asynchronously persisted value is visible.
cases.reason: Only observation is retried; the mutation is single-shot.
cases.acceptableCounterexample: This case itself is the counterexample.

cases.provenance: Reduced synthetic example derived from sentinel-development partial-setup cleanup learning.
cases.behavior: A created record is cleaned up even when membership setup fails.
cases.reason: A member-add failure after creation leaves cleanup without the record identity.
cases.acceptableCounterexample: Capture created.id immediately after creation, before any later fallible setup.

cases.provenance: Synthetic acceptable exception to searching only for expect in test bodies.
cases.behavior: Verify the selected account display name.
cases.reason: The called helper contains a behavior-specific assertion.
cases.acceptableCounterexample: This case itself is the counterexample.

cases.behavior: The switch changes its checked state during the current session.
cases.reason: Persistence across reload is outside this declared behavior; missing a persistence check is not a blocker here.
cases.acceptableCounterexample: A separate requirement promising persistence would require an additional test.

cases.behavior: Parse a downloaded export in a domain-specific module.
cases.reason: A single current consumer or utils suffix alone does not demonstrate an ownership defect.
cases.acceptableCounterexample: Actual duplicated incompatible UI ownership or a documented architecture violation needs separate evidence.
